## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
#first we calculate the diversity of all NR CPA proteins 

Sample_NR1<- read.delim('/home/mad149/Metagenome_grassmere/output_xblast_NRCPA/NRCPA/Z37TGN_sample_1_vs_NRCPA_DB_counted_and_mapped.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
Sample_NR2<- read.delim('/home/mad149/Metagenome_grassmere/output_xblast_NRCPA/NRCPA/Z37TGN_sample_2_vs_NRCPA_DB_counted_and_mapped.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

merged_1_2 <- merge(Sample_NR1, Sample_NR2, by = "Protein_id", all = TRUE)
merged_1_2[is.na(merged_1_2)] <- 0
merged_1_2$Total_reads_mapped_to_protein <- merged_1_2$Reads_mapped_to_protein.x + merged_1_2$Reads_mapped_to_protein.y

library(dplyr)

merged_1_2 <- merged_1_2 %>% 
  mutate(subfamily.x = coalesce(subfamily.x, subfamily.y))
Final_merged_1_2 <- merged_1_2[,c('Protein_id', 'subfamily.x', 'Total_reads_mapped_to_protein')]


Nsum_1_2 <- sum(Final_merged_1_2$Total_reads_mapped_to_protein)

Final_merged_1_2$ratio <-(Final_merged_1_2$Total_reads_mapped_to_protein)/Nsum_1_2
Final_merged_1_2$intermediate <- Final_merged_1_2$ratio*(log2(Final_merged_1_2$ratio))
Shannon_index_NR_1_2 <- -sum(Final_merged_1_2$intermediate)
Shannon_index_NR_1_2
Richness_NR_1_2 <- nrow(Final_merged_1_2)
Nsum_1_2


summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2 <- Final_merged_1_2 %>%
  group_by(subfamily.x) %>%
  summarise(total_value = sum(Total_reads_mapped_to_protein))
Richness_subfamilies_NR_1_2 <- nrow(summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2)
Richness_subfamilies_NR_1_2
summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$ratio <- (summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$total_value/Nsum_1_2)
summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$intermediate <- summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$ratio*(log2(summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$ratio))
Shannon_index_NR_1_2_subfamily <- -sum(summary_Subfamilies_NR_1_2$intermediate)
Shannon_index_NR_1_2_subfamily
```
